intro_html: Puts the two things HR always ends up keeping in a spreadsheet — who to call in an emergency, and when somebody's ID or passport stops being valid — back on the employee record, and warns the right person once, on the right day, instead of every morning until the document expires.

features.title: Dependants On The Record
features.desc: Name, relationship, phone and date of birth for every family member, on the HR-only private page — and a spouse already recorded on the personal page is added for you, without duplicating on re-save.

features.title: One Emergency Contact, Always
features.desc: Flagging a dependant copies their name and number onto the employee and unflags anyone else. Enforced in the database, not just the form, so imports and API calls obey the same rule.

features.title: Your Own Relationship List
features.desc: Spouse, Father, Mother, Son and Daughter ship with the module; add Guardian or anything else from Employees → Configuration.

features.title: ID And Passport, With Scans
features.desc: An expiry date for the identification reference, and somewhere to attach the scans for both it and the passport, right beside the numbers themselves.

features.title: Warned Once, On The Right Day
features.desc: The daily job matches today plus your lead time exactly, so nobody is e-mailed twice — plus a send-now button for chasing somebody today rather than waiting.

features.title: Wording You Control
features.desc: Both warning e-mails are standard editable templates, so you can rewrite or translate them without touching code.

features.title: A Joining Date That Is Right
features.desc: Computed from the employee's own employment history and not typeable over — not through the form, not through an import, not through the API — so it stops drifting from the truth.

features.title: A Login Always Has An Employee
features.desc: Every new internal login creates the matching employee record, linked both ways. Customer-facing and technical accounts never do, and the whole behaviour can be switched off.

limitations: Only the identification reference and the passport are tracked. Visas, work permits, driving licences and professional certifications are out of scope.
No employee self-service. HR maintains dependants; an employee has no menu for their own.
Document numbers are stored as free text — nothing validates a format or a checksum.
The automation runs one way only: a new internal login creates an employee, but creating an employee never creates a login.
Notice Period is read-only for HR Officers in the form rather than blocked at the server, and it is not backfilled onto employment records that already existed when the module was installed.
